name: 3-1:The Facility
short:
Why is there a
large-scale
facility
underneath
Ragol?
long:
Client: Principal
Quest:
 Please investigate the
 strange, large-scale
 facility that was
 discovered beneath
 Ragol's surface.
※ Job can be joined
 while in progress.

You're here. Good.
The truth is...

We've recently confirmed
that parts of the caverns
are not natural,

and in fact, are quite
clearly manmade!

Following a mine shaft,
we discovered a large-
scale facility!

I need top-rate hunters
like you to go and check
it out.

Who put it there? What
was it built to do --
or what's it still doing?

I know this is a lot, but
please, you must find the
answers!

As always, Irene can give
you the details.

And as usual, I'm
counting on you.

Please speak to Irene,
my secretary.
Rico...!

No, I didn't say
anything. Please continue
your investigation.
Attacked by machines?!
That's preposterous!
You must be mistaken.

Please, investigate this
matter more thoroughly.
Well, I see.

We may be able to get
additional data from that
underground computer.

We'll leave that for the
specialists.
But...

...please, you must
trust me on this:
if there are machines

down there, then that
means that there has to
have been sentient life!

Something's obviously
not right, now!

...you may stand down,
for now.

Please, go and rest until
we have further orders.

Where do you think you're
going?

You haven't spoken with
Irene for the details,
yet!
Here are the details:

Investigate and report on
the facility underneath
Ragol.

You should be able to
find it by going through
the mind shaft we found.

Please try to get a
general handle on the
situation down there.

A teleporter has already
been set up.

You can get to the mine
shaft directly from the
city, here.

With all of the goings-on
that we've encountered
with the planet Ragol,

we've come to expect the
unexpected.

Be careful en route to
your destination.
That's it.
Good luck.

An underground
facility...

There were a great many
scientists aboard
Pioneer 1.

Could they have been
researching the 
underground facility?

Maybe that underground
facility is somehow tied
to the earlier explosion?

So no animals this time?
But intelligent hostile
machines, you say?

Why are such dangerous
things down there?

The Principal is waiting.
Please give him your
report.
Welcome back.

So, you were actually
attacked by machines
down there?

Does this mean that
someone on Ragol had
the skill to build them?

I still don't understand
why they'd be located
underground, though.

We'll let you know
immediately when you're
needed.

Why don't you go and
take a break?

You've already finished
this request.

Please select "Cancel" at
the Counter to return to
the Lobby.

Perhaps Pioneer 1 built
that facility and kept
it hidden from us.

If there's an underground
facility, maybe that means
Pioneer 1 discovered

something down there.
What do you think?

Now machines are
attacking us?
I don't believe this!

We still don't know much
about what happened to
the Central Dome.

If they used their
materials to build the
Central Dome, though,

then it's hard to think
that Pioneer 1 could've
also built that facility.

Pioneer 1 could've had
this planned since the
beginning.

I think some parts of 
the ship were used to 
build the facility.

So you were attacked by
"typical" machines, then?

Is there intelligent life
on Ragol besides us?

This is all just so
baffling!

Chimera Subject Beta 772
has somehow escaped
from the laboratory!

It'll disrupt Ragol's
ecosystem if we don't
capture it in time!
We must find it!

But we're already in
danger of something else.

We're locked in here to
